     企業管治原則及常規                        CORPORATE GOVERNANCE PRINCIPLES AND
                                      PRACTICES

     大新金融集團有限公司（「本公司」或「本集團」）董         The Board of Directors (the “Board”) and the Management of Dah Sing
     事會及管理層竭力維持集團內高水平之企業管治            Financial Holdings Limited (“Company” or “Group”) are committed to
     並致力識別及規範最佳常規，我們深信完備及有            maintaining a high standard of corporate governance practices within
     效之企業管治常規對實現持續價值、提升企業誠            the Group and devote considerable effort to identify and formalize
     信文化及維持投資者信心十分重要。良好的企業            best practices. We believe that sound and effective corporate
     管治可促進及保障股東及其他持份者的利益，藉            governance practices are essential for delivering sustainable value,
     此提升本集團的公信力和聲譽。                   enhancing a culture of business integrity and maintaining investors’
                                      confidence. Good corporate governance promotes and safeguards

     董事會成員多元化政策                            Board Diversity Policy

     董事會於2013年12月3日採納董事會成員多元化              The Board has adopted a Board Diversity Policy (the “Policy”) on
     政策（「政策」），其主要條款如下：                     3 December 2013. The key terms of this Policy are set out as follows:


     1.   目的                               1.   Purpose


          本政策旨在列載本公司董事會為達致成員                    This Policy aims to set out the approach to achieve diversity
          多元化而採取的方針，從而有利於本公司                    on the Company’s Board in order to enhance the quality of
          及其整體業務，並提升公司的表現素質。                    its performance which in turn benefits the Company and its
                                                business as a whole.


     2.   政策聲明                             2.   Policy statement


          本公司明白並深信董事會成員多元化對支                    The Company recognizes and embraces the benefits of having
          持實現其可持續發展裨益良多。董事會成                    a diverse Board in supporting the attainment of its sustainable
          員多元化有多方面的考慮因素，包括但不                    development. Board diversity has been considered from a
          限 於 性 別、 年 齡、 種 族、 文 化 及 教 育 背        number of aspects, including but not limited to gender, age,
          景、專業經驗、技能、知識及服務任期。                    ethnicity, cultural and educational background, professional
          董事會所有委任均以用人唯才為原則，並                    experience, skills, knowledge and length of service. All Board
          在考慮人選時以客觀條件充分顧及上述之                    appointments will be based on meritocracy, and candidates will
          個人素質因素、對董事會貢獻之期望及董                    be considered against objective criteria, having due regard for
          事會成員多元化的裨益。                           the factors on personal attributes outlined above, expectation
                                                on contribution to the Board, and the benefit of diversity of the
                                                Board.


     3.   可計量目標                            3.   Measurable Objectives


          甄選人選將按一系列多元化範疇為基準，                    Selection of candidates will be based on a range of diversity
          包括但不限於性別、年齡、種族、文化及                    perspectives, including but not limited to gender, age, ethnicity,
          教育背景、專業經驗、技能、知識、獨立                    cultural and educational background, professional experience,
          性及服務任期。最終將按人選的長處及可                    skills, knowledge, independence and length of service. The
          為董事會提供的貢獻而作決定。                        ultimate decision will be based on merit and contribution that
                                                the selected candidates will bring to the Board.

          管治報告內審議及匯報本政策概要、實行                    governance report to the Board, a summary of the Policy, the
          本政策之可計量目標及達標進度。                       measurable objectives to implement the Policy and progress

                          standards.

董事會授權管理層負責制訂及維持健全之內部監           The Board has delegated to management the responsibility to
控制度。內部監控制度擬通過管理及營運監控、           develop and maintain a sound internal control system. The internal
風險管理制度架構之運作，使董事會可監察本集           control system, operating through a framework of management and
團之業務表現及財務狀況、監控及調節風險、採           operational controls, and risk management systems, is intended to
納健全之業務守則、合理確證對欺詐及誤差之監           allow the Board to monitor the Group’s business performance and
控、確保遵守適用法例及規則，以及對管理人員           financial positions, to control and adjust risk exposures, to adopt
作出監察及提供指引，以達成本公司之目標。然           sound business practices, to obtain reasonable assurance on controls
而，本集團之內部監控程序僅可對重大誤差、損           against fraud and errors, to ensure compliance with applicable laws
失或欺詐提供合理而非絕對之保證。                and regulations, and to exercise oversight on and provide guidance
                                to management in achieving the Company’s objectives. However, it
                                should be recognized that the Group’s internal control procedures

     環境、社會及管治的理念                      Our Philosophy in ESG

     大新集團的環境、社會及管治理念貫徹在日常營            The ESG philosophy of the Dah Sing Group is embedded in our
     運中。我們致力於在經濟增長與公司發展及社區            day-to-day operations. It is about striving to reach a balance
     利益與環境保護之間取得平衡，更將可持續發展            between economic and company growth, community interest and
     視為對本集團長遠發展策略及營運上的重要一環。           environmental protection, and treating sustainability both strategically
                                      and operationally on importance, and for the long-term development
                                      of the Group.


     我們的可持續發展方向由高級管理層成員及本集            Our sustainable development direction is overseen by the Corporate
     團若干業務及支援部門主管組成之企業社會責任            Social Responsibility Committee (“CSR Committee”), which
     委員會監督，適時對環境、社會及管治相關風險            comprises members of senior management and certain heads
     的性質及範圍進行評估及審閱。我們已制定風險            of Business and Support functions of the Group. The nature and
     管理及內部監控系統，以管理及控制風險以實現            extent of ESG related risks are evaluated and reviewed whenever
     業務目標。我們亦已制定營商原則和價值觀的標            appropriate. Risk management and internal control systems are in
     準，把可持續發展承諾貫徹在日常業務營運中。            place to manage and control the risk of failure to achieve business
     我們設有企業社會責任政策，為本集團企業社會            objectives. A standard riding on our Guiding Principles and Values,
     責任與業務營運之間取得平衡策略發展提供指引。           and thus embodying our sustainability commitment in our daily
                                      business operations, was in place. The CSR Policy had also been

      2.2 綜合財務報表                                         2.2 Consolidation

      綜合財務報表包括本公司及其所有附屬公司截至                              The consolidated financial statements include the financial
      12 月 31 日止之財務報表。                                   statements of the Company and all its subsidiaries made up to 31
                                                         December.


           （甲） 附屬公司                                             (a)   Subsidiaries

            附屬公司是本集團可控制之實體（包括結構                                 A subsidiary is an entity (including a structured entity) over
            性實體）。本集團可控制該實體是指當本集                                 which the Group has control. The Group controls an entity
            團透過參與該實體而面對或有權獲取可變                                  when the Group is exposed to, or has rights to, variable returns
            的回報，且有能力藉着對該實體之權力影                                  from its involvement with the entity and has the ability to affect
            響該等回報。自控制權轉移予本集團當日                                  those returns through its power over the entity. Subsidiaries are
            起附屬公司作綜合計算，並由該控制權終                                  consolidated from the date on which control is transferred to
            止之日起不再綜合計算。                                         the Group. They are deconsolidated from the date that control
                                                                ceases.


            本集團以收購會計法為本集團之業務合併                                  The acquisition method of accounting is used to account
            列賬。收購一間附屬公司所付出之代價為                                  for business combinations by the Group. The consideration
            已轉移資產、承擔之負債及本集團發行之                                  transferred for the acquisition of a subsidiary is the fair values
            權益之公平值。所付出代價包括任何或然                                  of the assets transferred, the liabilities incurred and the equity
            代價安排之資產或負債之公平值。收購相                                  interests issued by the Group. The consideration transferred
            關之費用於產生時支銷。在業務合併過程                                  includes the fair value of any asset or liability resulting from
            中取得所收購可被認明資產及承擔之負債                                  a contingent consideration arrangement. Acquisition-related
            及或然負債，均於收購當日按其公平值作                                  costs are expensed as incurred. Identifiable assets acquired
            出初始計量。本集團根據逐項收購基準按                                  and liabilities and contingent liabilities assumed in a business

      實際利率法乃是一種用以計算金融資產或金融負                              The effective interest method is a method of calculating the amortised
      債之攤餘成本及其於相關期內攤分利息收入或利                              cost of a financial asset or a financial liability and of allocating the
      息支出的方法。實際利率指可將金融工具在預計                              interest income or interest expense over the relevant period. The
      有效期間或較短期間（如適用）內之估計未來現金                             effective interest rate is the rate that exactly discounts estimated
      收支貼現為該金融資產或金融負債之賬面淨值之                              future cash payments or receipts through the expected life of the
      適用貼現率。在計算實際利率時，本集團按金融                              financial instrument or, when appropriate, a shorter period to the
      工具之所有合約條款（如提早清還之行使權）而估                             net carrying amount of the financial asset or financial liability. When
      計其現金流量，但不考慮未發生之信貸損失。此                              calculating the effective interest rate, the Group estimates cash
      計算包括所有合約內交易雙方所收取或支付能構                              flows considering all contractual terms of the financial instrument (for
       成整體實際利息之費用及利率差價、交易成本及                             example, prepayment options) but does not consider future credit
       所有其他溢價或折讓。                                        losses. The calculation includes all fees and points paid or received
                                                         between parties to the contract that are an integral part of the effective
                                                         interest rate, transaction costs and all other premiums or discounts.


       若一項金融資產或一組金融資產的價值因減值虧                             Once a financial asset or a group of similar financial assets has been
       損被調低，其利息收入則按計算有關減值虧損時                             written down as a result of an impairment loss, interest income is
       所應用以貼現未來現金流量之利率來計量確認。                             recognised using the rate of interest used to discount the future cash
                                                         flows for the purpose of measuring the impairment loss.

      收回。                                                on collateral and the value of the collateral is such that there is no

      3.4.1 流動資金風險管理程序                                   3.4.1 Liquidity risk management process

      本集團按審慎原則管理資金流動性，旨在符合法                              The Group manages its liquidity on a prudent basis with the objective
      定準則及確保有充足之流動性及融資能力，以應                              to comply with the statutory standard and to ensure that there is an
      付日常的業務營運及能承受不短於 1 個月之持續                            adequate liquidity and funding capacity to meet normal business
      資金壓力。本集團已採納香港金管局指定之流動                              operations and to withstand a prolonged period of liquidity stress
      資產維持比率（「流動資產維持比率」）及核心資金                            of not less than a month. The Group has adopted the Liquidity
      比率（「核心資金比率」）為呈報本集團流動資金狀                            Maintenance Ratio (“LMR”) and the Core Funding Ratio (“CFR”)
      況之監管準則。本集團於期內保持流動資產維持                              as a regulatory standard specified by the HKMA for reporting on
       比率遠高於法定最低要求的 25% 及足夠高的核心                          the Group’s liquidity position. During the period, the Group had
       資金比率，旨在確保銀行有充裕穩定的資金來源                             maintained a sufficiently high LMR well above the statutory minimum
       融資其業務。                                            of 25% and a sufficiently high CFR to ensure that the Group can fund
                                                         its activities with sufficiently stable sources of funding.

3.4.1 流動資金風險管理程序（續）       3.4.1 Liquidity risk management process (Continued)

流動性風險管理乃遵照經董事會批准之政策及框     Liquidity risk management is governed by the policy and framework
架管理，據此授權本集團的資產及負債管理委員     approved by the Board, which delegates to the Group’s ALCO to
會監控流動性風險管理。本集團的資產及負債管     oversee liquidity risk management. The ALCO regularly reviews the
理委員會定期檢討本集團之貸款及存款的組合及     Group’s loan and deposit mix and changes, funding requirements and
變化、融資需求及預測，以及對一系列包括流動     projections, and monitors a set of liquidity risk metrics, including the
資產維持比率、核心資金比率及到期錯配狀況之     LMR, CFR and maturity mismatch on an ongoing basis. Appropriate
流動性風險度量作持續監控。本集團對此等風險     limits or triggers on these risk metrics are set and sufficient liquid
度量訂定適當的限額及觸發額，並持有充足的流     assets are held to ensure that the Group can meet all short-term

      3.5 金融資產及負債之公平值                                    3.5 Fair values of financial assets and liabilities

           （甲） 公平值之釐定                                           (a)   Determination of fair value

            公平值受限於須由董事會負責確保本集團                                  Fair values are subject to a control framework that the Board is
            有適當的估值管治及控制程序之控制框                                   held responsible for ensuring proper valuation governance and
            架。董事會授權財資及投資風險委員會監                                  control processes of the Group. It delegates the responsibility
            管金融工具之估值程序。估值由風險管理                                  for overseeing the valuation process for financial instruments to
            及監控部和獨立專業合資格估值師及精算                                  the TIRC. Valuation is performed independently by RMCD and
            師（如適用）獨立地進行，而估值結果乃定                                 where appropriate, by independent and professionally qualified
            期驗證，確保公平值計量過程之完整性。                                  valuers and the valuation results are periodically verified to
                                                                ensure the integrity of the fair value measurement process.


            金融工具之公平值乃在目前市場情況下市                                  The fair value of financial instruments is the price that would be
            場參與者於計量日進行之有序交易中出售                                  received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly
            資產所收取或轉移負債所支付之價格，不                                  transaction between market participants at the measurement
            論該價格為直接可觀察或使用估值方法估                                  date under current market conditions regardless of whether
            計。                                                  that price is directly observable or estimated using a valuation
                                                                technique.


            凡金融工具之報價隨時且定期由交易所、                                  A financial instrument is regarded as quoted in an active market
            交易商、經紀人、行業組織、定價服務及                                  if quoted prices are readily and regularly available from an
            監管機構發佈，則被視作為活躍市場報價                                  exchange, dealer, broker, industry group, pricing service or
            之金融工具。於活躍市場之報價為公平值                                  regulatory agency. A quoted price in an active market provides
            提 供 最 可 靠 之 證 據， 並 須 於 可 獲 得 時 使                    the most reliable evidence of fair value and shall be used
            用。倘金融資產或金融負債有買入價及賣                                  whenever available. If a financial asset or a financial liability has
            出價，本集團將採用買賣差價中 在該等情                                 a bid price and an ask price, the price within the bid-ask spread
            況下最能代表公平值之價格。                                       that is most representative of fair value in the circumstances is
                                                                used by the Group.


            倘金融工具之可觀察市場報價未能直接獲                                  Where observable market quotation of financial instruments is
            得，本集團利用合適及獲廣泛認可之估值                                  not directly available, the Group estimates the fair value of such
            方法估計該等金融工具之公平值，包括現                                  financial instruments by using appropriate valuation techniques
            值方法及標準期權定價模型。於應用該等                                  that are widely recognised including present value techniques
            金融工具之估值方法時，本集團盡最大限                                  and standard option pricing models. In applying valuation
            度使用相關可觀察依據（例如：利率、匯                                  techniques for these financial instruments, the Group maximises
            率、波動性、信貸息差），而盡最少限度使                                 the use of relevant observable inputs (for examples, interest
            用不可觀察依據。例如利率掉期合約之公                                  rates, foreign exchange rates, volatilities, credit spreads) and
            平值按估計的未來現金流之現值計算。遠                                  minimises the use of unobservable inputs. For example, the
            期外匯合約之公平值一般根據現行遠期匯                                  fair value of interest-rate swaps is calculated as the present
            率計算，而期權合約之公平值則按合適之                                  value of the estimated future cash flows, the fair value of foreign
            定價模型計算，如 Black-Scholes 模型。                          exchange forward contracts is generally based on current
                                                                forward rates and the fair value of option contracts is derived
                                                                using appropriate pricing models, such as Black-Scholes
                                                                model.

      （乙）投資之減值測試及於 2018 年確認之減                            (b)    Impairment testing on the investment and impairment
         值                                                      recognised in 2018

      於 2018 年 12 月 31 日，本集團在重慶銀行之投資                     At 31 December 2018, the fair value of the Group’s investment in
      之公平值已低於賬面值大約 60 個月。為此，本集                           BOCQ had been below the carrying amount for approximately 60
      團持續對在重慶銀行之投資之賬面值進行減值測                              months. On this basis, the Group continues to perform an impairment
      試以評估可收回金額。根據於2016年及之前進行                            test on the carrying amount of the investment in BOCQ to assess the
      之評估，可收回金額被評定為高於賬面值，故無                              recoverable amount. Based on the assessment conducted in 2016
      需確認減值。                                             and before, the recoverable amount was assessed as higher than the
                                                         carrying amount, and no impairment needed to be recognised.

      減值測試比對以計算使用價值而釐定之重慶銀行                              The impairment test is performed by comparing the recoverable
      可收回金額和該投資之賬面值。使用價值乃按照                              amount of BOCQ, determined by a value in use (“VIU”) calculation,
      管理層估量之重慶銀行盈利和未來將派股息，及                              with the carrying amount of the investment. The VIU calculation uses
      經考慮重慶銀行中期和長期之增長及資產淨值後                              discounted cash flow projections based on management’s estimates
      之預期未來的可能脫手價值，應用貼現現金流量                              of BOCQ’s earnings and dividends to be paid in future, and the
      預測計算。應用於使用價值計算之貼現率乃參考                              estimated probable exit value in future after considering the growth
      可於公開市場獲取之重慶銀行股本成本而估算。                              of BOCQ and its net asset value for the medium and longer term.
                                                         The discount rate applied to the VIU calculation was estimated with
                                                         reference to BOCQ's cost of equity, which is publicly available in the
                                                         market.

      進行使用價值計算以得出該投資之可收回金額                               In performing the VIU calculation to arrive at the recoverable amount
      時，本集團考慮所有相關因素包括市場觀點及質                              of the investment, the Group considers all relevant factors including
      化因素以確保計算使用價值之參數合適。調整亦                              market views and qualitative factors to ensure that the inputs to the
      須作出以反映影響重慶銀行之最新情況及對預測                              VIU calculation are appropriate. Adjustments need to be made to
      重慶銀行未來表現有關之中期及長期市場展望。                              reflect the latest situation affecting BOCQ and also market outlook for
      在估算重慶銀行之未來現金流當中需要管理層作                              the medium and longer term that are relevant in projecting BOCQ’s
      重要判斷。                                              future performance. Significant management judgement is required in
                                                         estimating the future cash flows of BOCQ.

      一方，或對另一方在作出財務及營運決策方面行                              indirectly, to control the other party or exercise significant influence
      使重大影響力。倘若其他不同人士受到共同控制                              over the other party in making financial and operating decisions.
      或共同重大影響時，彼等人士亦被視為有關連人                              Parties are also considered to be related if they are subject to
      士。                                                 common control or common significant influence.

      排，以減低信貸風險。淨額結算協議規定，一旦                              arrangements with counterparties whenever possible. Netting
      出現違約事件，所有涉及交易對手之未完成交易                              agreements provide that, if an event of default occurs, all outstanding
      均會終止，而所有結欠款項將拼合按淨額結算。                              transactions with the counterparty will be terminated and all amounts
      如非發生違約事件，所有與對手之交易會以總額                              outstanding will be settled on a net basis. Except for the event of
      結算及一般不會在財務狀況表中對銷資產及負                               default, all outstanding transactions with the counterparty are settled
      債。                                                 on a gross basis and generally do not result in offsetting the assets
                                                         and liabilities in the statement of financial position.
